main.summary: Rollback-on-dispose scope for a content mutation performed while a DataItem data gate is held.
main.remarks: The scope captures the shared DataItem state and an optional type-specific payload memento. Call Commit only after payload, integrity, and assertion updates succeed. If the scope is disposed without commit, it restores payload first, then shared state.

field.name: item
field.summary: Item whose content transition is in progress.

field.name: snapshot
field.summary: Captured shared and type-specific state to restore if the mutation is rejected.

field.name: committed
field.summary: Whether the content mutation has been accepted.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Capture the item's current state for a content mutation.
constructor.param: Item being changed. Its data gate must already be held.

method.name: Commit
method.summary: Run the caller's commit action and accept the mutation.
method.param: Commit action, such as updating the item's modification timestamp. It must not throw after performing an irreversible side effect.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Restore the captured state unless the mutation was committed.
